items:
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the CB of 
 the pump motor.

Isolate the pump 
 mechanically by closing suction and delivery valves.

Be sure pump must 
 be completely
 drained.

Measure vibration level for bearing and compare it with the setting values, 
 then analyze it and determine what to do [if it is needed].

Check discharge, pressure and compare them with the setting values then 
 replace the worn-out components [if it is needed].
Check the alignment and compare with the setting values.
Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it [if it is needed].
Grease the bearings of the pump.(type of grease is multi-purpose grease).
Check the leakage from the glands and flanges and treat it.
Change the packing seal between the shaft and the wear ring.

Introduction
This document outlines 
the equipment inspection
I1, to be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
This pump transfers the condensate from the hot 
well of condenser to the condensate pre-heaters then to the deaerator then to 
the feed tank.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the CB of 
 the pump motor.
Isolate the pump 
 mechanically by closing suction and delivery valves.
Be sure pump must 
 be completely
 drained.
Tools and Equipment
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, 
 Grease, Rags
Feeler gauge & 
 dial indicator.
Dial indicator, 
 Vibrometer.
Work to be Carried Out
Pump in Service
Measure vibration level for bearing and compare it with the setting values, 
 then analyze it and determine what to do [if it is needed].
Check discharge, pressure and compare them with the setting values then 
 replace the worn-out components [if it is needed].
Pump 
out of Service
Check the alignment and compare with the setting values.
Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it [if it is needed].
Grease the bearings of the pump.(type of grease is multi-purpose grease).
Check the leakage from the glands and flanges and treat it.
Change the packing seal between the shaft and the wear ring.
Repaint the casing against rust.
